applicabilityBasis.summary: GGBR references and redeems against gold priced per troy ounce rather than a fixed amount of U.S. monetary value. It is therefore a commodity token, not a GENIUS payment stablecoin, even though Goldfish calls it a gold-backed stablecoin.

references.label: GENIUS Act: payment stablecoin definition tied to fixed monetary value

genius.notes: GGBR is a gold-backed commodity claim and not a fixed-dollar payment stablecoin. The SEC-hosted I-ON Digital exhibit identifies GGBR Inc. as a Wyoming company and describes the Goldfish product, but it is not a GENIUS Act authorization or application.
